fact: Webb Fontaine reports that after seven years of operation the Guinean Single Window for Foreign Trade (GUCEG) connects commercial banks, the Central Bank, Customs, port authorities, land border posts and economic operators.

ECOWAS says it launched deployment of SIGMAT between Cote d'Ivoire, Guinea and Liberia on 31 October 2025, exchanging electronic transit messages through interconnection of their national customs systems.
The UN Global Survey 2025 rates Guinea's Automated Customs System as fully implemented.
Africa Guinee reports Guinea's customs use the SYDONIA customs platform, on which System FIRST Guinea will issue and manage the electronic cargo tracking note under a 28 August 2025 agreement.
